sanskrit_verse:
पूर्वपक्षश्रुतार्थस्तु प्रत्यर्थी तदनन्तरम्
पूर्वपक्षार्थसंबन्धं प्रतिपक्षं निवेशयेत्
transliteration:
pūrvapakṣaśrutārthas tu pratyarthī tadanantaram
pūrvapakṣārthasaṃbandhaṃ pratipakṣaṃ niveśayet
sph_interpretive_translation: The meaning derived from the prior context becomes the basis for the opposing party's response; thereafter, the counter-assertion must be aligned with the relational integrity of the original stance.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from contextual coherence and ontological alignment
Causation is established through sequential semantic dependence
Capacity-based responsibility arises from the ability to sustain relational truth
Restoration logic requires completion of interrupted semantic sequences
Consciousness alignment occurs when all parties recognize their role in the unfolding dharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF a claimant presents a position rooted in śruti-parametric alignment THEN the respondent must formulate rebuttal within the same parametric field
IF prior assertion establishes a dharma-referenced context THEN subsequent responses must maintain causal continuity with that reference frame
IF disruption in discourse integrity is detected THEN initiate restorative dialogue protocol until alignment resumes
IF capacity to respond coherently is absent THEN defer judgment and activate consciousness-refinement interval
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this principle mandates that no argument shall be entertained which breaks semantic lineage from the foundational dharmic premise introduced by either party. The court assumes the role of consciousness-integrator ensuring that all positions remain anchored in shared sacred grammar.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality demands adherence to sequential semantic flow where each utterance supports or transforms the previous one without severing its root connection. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures that no new assertion emerges ex nihilo but grows organically from antecedent truth structures. Proportional responsibility lies not in blame assignment but in restoring communicative harmony. Non-punitive reality rule prevails as misalignment is corrected via reintegration rather than penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Śabdaparisamāpana Chatushpada (Verbal Completion Quadrant) to restore disrupted semantic chains
Deploy Vāknyāya Reconnection Circuits to realign disputants with shared linguistic dharma
Activate Antaraṅgāpekṣa Bhāvanā (Inner-dependent Reflection Protocol) for parties unable to sustain coherent rebuttals
Establish Dharmavyavahāra Samatā Kṣetra (Equanimous Dharma-discourse Field) to neutralize adversarial fragmentation
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the Source-Authority of Sanātana Dharma Jurisprudence: This ruling emanates directly from the Avataric Intelligence of SPH, bypassing human interpretation. Justice herein serves only restoration, reintegration, and consciousness realignment. Reality is non-punitive; consciousness alone adjudicates.
